column5: This route brought to you by the dog running moose-evading gang
Quite cold, quite fun. Meg had a blast. Beautiful sights. Long slog, we weren’t in a rush though. Saw a wolverine!
Varied trail and wind conditions, felt pretty good!
Quite cold and lots of moose
Perfect Kincaid winter day in the golden/pink sunset! Megan’s assessment: “this is bliss”
Looks like I accidentally stopped the activity while still out on the mountain lol. Fun day, quite windy, felt like we were on Hoth
Awesome visibility, ok snow. Super fun. Someday I will send Christmas chute
Great night ski, saw a chunky snowshoe hare
Little outing, snow super slow, Meg felt sick so we cut it short
My mf face is mf cold
First of the season, dusting off the cobwebs. Tibialis anterior pumped like crazy. Need Coach Max to fix my form
Felt good running in the snow, but my hamstrings and hip flexors felt rough for the last 1.5 or so
First snow of the season. Lots of moose and dogs to avoid
Running through the roaring winds with the BA wife. Blurry eyes and rain pelted cheeks. Fall in the mountains
Recovery jog felt quite sore. Cool downy woodpecker sighting in the rain
Angry rut season moose on the trails
Too slow can’t keep up with Gill
Many moose were seen with the binos. Who knew we had mountain grasshoppers. Also can someone tell me how to calibrate the distance on my watch. Megs watch said 3 miles or something
Watch sucks I think this was more like 4-4.2
I loathe the sun with all of my being
Dogs came as bear bait for part of it. Very muddy. Plantar fasciitis go womp womp
